children.name: Goniocladia grahamensis Moore, 1929
children.description: Reticulate colonies consisting of anastomosing bifoliate branches. Branches 0.54 – 0.70 mm wide. Fenestrules oval to polygonal, 1.00 – 1.36 mm wide and 2.32 – 2.66 mm long. Autozooecia budding in 2 – 3 rows from each side of thin mesotheca, opening on both sides of the sharp median carina. Lunaria present, horseshoe-shaped, directed toward fenestrule. Numerous microstylets on the colony surface, 0.008 – 0.011 mm in diameter.
